## Checklist

- [ ] The [checks](https://github.com/marcelorsdd/OpenPSApp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#checks) for every part I touched pass locally.
- [ ] Tests cover the change.
- [ ] No code comments unless truly necessary.
- [ ] New or updated dependencies are pinned exactly and at least 14 days old.
- [ ] User-facing text is translated into English, Portuguese (Brazil) and Spanish.
- [ ] Console UI changes work in the PS5 browser (Safari 13.1).
- [ ] Docs are updated: README, `SYNC.md` if what the console sends changed, the area README, and `CHANGELOG.md` under `Unreleased`.
- [ ] No console ids, PSN ids, tokens, IP addresses or personal names.
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits.
